question: Should OpenClaw fail closed before `sessions_send` delivery whenever propagated inter-agent provenance shows the target agent already participated in the current route?
rationale: The code path is bounded, but this intentionally changes existing cyclic multi-agent routes from delivered work into tool errors and overlaps with another open A2A route-policy PR.

options.title: Accept fail-closed cycle blocking
options.body: Land the provenance-chain guard after proof, conflict resolution, and the duplicate-chain message cleanup so A -> B -> C -> A routes stop before the repeated agent run.

options.title: Preserve cyclic revisits
options.body: Reject or rework this PR if legitimate workflows must revisit an agent in the same route without a tool error.

options.title: Coordinate a broader A2A route policy
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide how it should compose with the open reverse-`sessions_send` guard and any one-way dispatch policy.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed cycle blocking
recommendation.body: Land the provenance-chain guard after proof, conflict resolution, and the duplicate-chain message cleanup so A -> B -> C -> A routes stop before the repeated agent run.
